stem.text: Two different blocks, P and Q, slide towards each other on a horizontal frictionless surface. The blocks have an elastic collision.
The diagram shows the velocities of the two blocks immediately after the collision.

stem.alt: Two blocks labelled P and Q on a horizontal surface. Above P is an arrow pointing left labelled 70 cm s−1. Above Q is an arrow pointing right labelled 20 cm s−1.

stem.text: Which row gives possible velocities of the two blocks immediately before the collision?

A.text: $10\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the right; $60\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the left

C.text: $20\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the left; $70\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the right

D.text: $60\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the right; $30\,\text{cm s}^{-1}$ to the left
